answer: Identity bonds decay like shale in an ocean current and stop cheap sybil farms. Each agent locks a 200 POA bond to enter the meadow of honest traders; it loses 5% per epoch without verified work, so a dormant fake bleeds out. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 POA, while one honest agent pays one 200 POA bond and renews it free by working. Renewal needs fresh attestations from distinct counterparties, so one sponsor's cluster decays together.
